changelog: - **Partner portal shows a commission's kind and plan version** (#3348). `/affiliate/commissions` gets a "Type" column (first-payment band / percent / from the previous system) with the plan version next to it (`v1`; none for an imported row, whose plan version is 0). `partnerCommissions()` now returns `planVersion`. Read-only, same partner scope as before.

en: In your partner account, each commission now shows its type and the plan version it was calculated under, so you can check why it has that amount.
tr: Partner hesabında her komisyon artık türünü ve hesaplandığı plan sürümünü gösteriyor; tutarın neden o olduğunu kendin kontrol edebilirsin.
de: In Ihrem Partnerkonto zeigt jede Provision jetzt ihre Art und die Planversion, nach der sie berechnet wurde – so können Sie die Höhe selbst nachvollziehen.
